```{python}
#| label: fig-matrix-aggregation
#| fig-cap: 'RAPPA Matrix Aggregation Process. Individual sparse pairwise comparison matrices (each citizen evaluates only a few random pairs) are aggregated via geometric mean. The eigenvector method extracts a global priority vector from the aggregated matrix, synthesizing collective preferences from distributed judgments.'
#| echo: false

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle
from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    setup_chart_style,
    add_watermark,
    save_figure_with_margins,
    get_figure_output_path
)

# Apply consistent styling
setup_chart_style()

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))

# Options for visualization
options = ['Healthcare', 'Education', 'Defense', 'Parks']
n_options = len(options)

# --- Subplot 1: Individual Sparse Matrices ---
ax1 = plt.subplot(1, 4, 1)
ax1.set_title('Citizen 1\n(Sparse Matrix)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Create sparse matrix (mostly NaN, few comparisons)
matrix1 = np.full((n_options, n_options), np.nan)
matrix1[0, 1] = 0.7  # Healthcare vs Education: 70/30
matrix1[1, 0] = 0.3
matrix1[2, 3] = 0.4  # Defense vs Parks: 40/60
matrix1[3, 2] = 0.6

im1 = ax1.imshow(matrix1, cmap='RdYlGn', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
ax1.set_xticks(range(n_options))
ax1.set_yticks(range(n_options))
ax1.set_xticklabels(options, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_yticklabels(options, fontsize=8)

# Add text values
for i in range(n_options):
    for j in range(n_options):
        if not np.isnan(matrix1[i, j]):
            text = ax1.text(j, i, f'{matrix1[i, j]:.1f}',
                           ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# --- Subplot 2: Another Individual Sparse Matrix ---
ax2 = plt.subplot(1, 4, 2)
ax2.set_title('Citizen 2\n(Sparse Matrix)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

matrix2 = np.full((n_options, n_options), np.nan)
matrix2[0, 2] = 0.8  # Healthcare vs Defense: 80/20
matrix2[2, 0] = 0.2
matrix2[1, 3] = 0.5  # Education vs Parks: 50/50
matrix2[3, 1] = 0.5

im2 = ax2.imshow(matrix2, cmap='RdYlGn', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
ax2.set_xticks(range(n_options))
ax2.set_yticks(range(n_options))
ax2.set_xticklabels(options, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_yticklabels(options, fontsize=8)

for i in range(n_options):
    for j in range(n_options):
        if not np.isnan(matrix2[i, j]):
            text = ax2.text(j, i, f'{matrix2[i, j]:.1f}',
                           ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# --- Subplot 3: Aggregated Matrix (Geometric Mean) ---
ax3 = plt.subplot(1, 4, 3)
ax3.set_title('Aggregated Matrix\n(Geometric Mean)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Create a denser aggregated matrix (combining all citizens' inputs)
matrix_agg = np.array([
    [0.50, 0.65, 0.75, 0.55],
    [0.35, 0.50, 0.60, 0.52],
    [0.25, 0.40, 0.50, 0.45],
    [0.45, 0.48, 0.55, 0.50]
])

im3 = ax3.imshow(matrix_agg, cmap='RdYlGn', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
ax3.set_xticks(range(n_options))
ax3.set_yticks(range(n_options))
ax3.set_xticklabels(options, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_yticklabels(options, fontsize=8)

for i in range(n_options):
    for j in range(n_options):
        text = ax3.text(j, i, f'{matrix_agg[i, j]:.2f}',
                       ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=7)

# --- Subplot 4: Priority Vector (Eigenvector) ---
ax4 = plt.subplot(1, 4, 4)
ax4.set_title('Global Priority\n(Eigenvector)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Calculate priority vector (normalized weights)
priorities = np.array([0.35, 0.28, 0.20, 0.17])  # Healthcare > Education > Defense > Parks

colors = ['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb', '#e78ac3']
bars = ax4.barh(options, priorities, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Budget Share', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 0.4)
ax4.invert_yaxis()

# Add percentage labels
for i, (opt, priority) in enumerate(zip(options, priorities)):
    ax4.text(priority + 0.01, i, f'{priority:.0%}', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

# Add arrows between subplots to show flow
fig.text(0.23, 0.5, '→', fontsize=24, ha='center', va='center', color='gray')
fig.text(0.46, 0.5, '→', fontsize=24, ha='center', va='center', color='gray')
fig.text(0.69, 0.5, '→', fontsize=24, ha='center', va='center', color='gray')

# Add explanatory text
fig.text(0.23, 0.08, 'Many Citizens\n(Sparse Inputs)', fontsize=8, ha='center', style='italic', color='gray')
fig.text(0.46, 0.08, 'Geometric Mean\nAggregation', fontsize=8, ha='center', style='italic', color='gray')
fig.text(0.69, 0.08, 'Eigenvector\nCentrality', fontsize=8, ha='center', style='italic', color='gray')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.12, 1, 1])

# Add watermark and save
add_watermark(fig)
output_path = get_figure_output_path('rappa-matrix-aggregation.png')
save_figure_with_margins(fig, output_path)
```
